verdict.rationale: Notte documents an official MCP server (docs.notte.cc/mcp-server). It lets AI agents start cloud browser sessions, interact with pages, fetch data and build scripts. Integration guides point CrewAI and Vercel AI SDK MCP clients at it, and a probe confirmed the documentation page exists. Missing for 10: setup, transport and tool-list details in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described.
